svg.title: Sortline: from one photo to a cleaner city
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough. 1, a photo is scanned and the AI boxes plastic, metal, cardboard and organic waste. 2, a citizen drops a geotagged report of a garbage spot. 3, a cleanup crew uploads an after photo and the AI verifies nothing is left before closing it. 4, a household sells sorted recyclables and a collector picks them up. 5, the dashboard adds up kilograms recovered and CO2e avoided.

g.text: waste still visible? closing is rejected
